_source: Copied from seq23/aplayer-mode packages/policy/src/index.ts (PLAN_PRICES and CHIEF_OF_STAFF_INTRO_OFFERS), the ONLY price source for A Player Mode. Pinned at aplayer-mode commit cc751d1 on 2026-10-07. Never retype a price here by hand: change it in aplayer-mode first, then copy. scripts/validators/validate_aplayermode_landing.mjs compares this file to that source whenever a checkout is available (APLAYER_MODE_DIR, ../aplayer-mode or ~/aplayer-mode) and compares aplayermode/index.html to this file always.
